label: hAP ac²
description: MikroTik hAP ac² (RBD52G-5HacD2HnD-TC) — 5x 1G RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz. ARM 32bit 4-core IPQ-4018.
notes: Inlet is eth1, and there is no PoE-out. https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/hap-ac-2/ (read 2026-11-28): "The device accepts power from the power jack or from the first Ethernet port (Passive PoE) ... first Ethernet port accepts passive Power over Ethernet accepts 18-28 V DC". https://mikrotik.com/product/hap_ac2: Number of DC inputs 2 (DC jack, PoE-IN), PoE in Passive PoE, PoE in input Voltage 18-28 V, Max power consumption 21 W, Max power consumption without attachments 16 W, no PoE-out row. eth1 draws 16 W; eth2-eth5 are poeIn: false.
